verdict.rationale: The product is itself agent-oriented documentation: it ships as an open Agent Skills folder with a SKILL.md that agents load and pick up from its description, so a user can point an agent at it. There is no llms.txt or separate agent-facing docs surface, and the probe for a markdown docs endpoint returned 404. Missing for 10: an llms.txt file, agent-oriented reference docs beyond the SKILL.md itself, and a working machine-readable docs endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: The skill uses the open Agent Skills format (a folder with a SKILL.md), so it works in any agent that supports skills
Start a new session and ask for a logo; the agent picks the skill up from its description.
